question: Does expected observation value in the training mask prior improve heldout missing-query accuracy beyond random masks, geometric coverage and extra random training? Separate entropy J from Bayes classification gain V.
family: Connected randomly relabelled bipartite cycle with 32 extra cross-partition edges. Three leading nonconstant eigenvectors of self-looped symmetric normalized adjacency define a smooth field v=U z/sqrt(3), z uniform Rademacher^3. Each column of U has RMS1. Hidden feature parity g, label parity t and global label orientation sigma are independent uniform bits. X[:,0]=v*b^g+N(0,.4^2), X[:,1]=.6*v*b^g+N(0,.4^2); Y_i independent Bernoulli(sigmoid(2*sigma*v_i*b_i^t)) conditional on these 64 equally weighted states. All parameters/family are fixed and known to the reference. This finite mixture is not the old median/RMS Gaussian generator, a general Gaussian process, or an unknown-family teacher.
teacher: Exact enumeration over all64 latent states. Context locations are sampled independently of labels, never class-balanced. Observe raw Gaussian feature values, with no per-mask centering/RMS/clip. For each graph/design score Jhat=mean KL(Bern(p_X)||Bern(p_0)) and Vhat=mean(max(p_X,1-p_X)-max(p_0,1-p_0)) using256 independent prior realizations, shared across candidate masks. Posterior enumeration is exact; expected design values are Monte Carlo estimates, not exact risks. Negative finite-MC V estimates are retained. Labels for all query nodes are integrated analytically when scoring.
selection: C,Q and12 fixed-budget source candidate sets use graph/design RNG only. Sources never overlap C or Q. Expected-value draws use a separate RNG; the actual task realization is sampled independently after selection. Both entropy/decision/geometry retain the same50% uniform component and otherwise select uniformly among their top3 candidates. Random picks a uniform candidate. Geometry uses mean exp(-shortest_distance) to sources for C and Q with equal weight. The same graph, C,Q,candidate pool, independent actual X/Y and fixed mask budget are shared across arms. Hidden actual features/labels/mechanism are never arguments of the mask selector.
training: Unchanged public GraphPFN wrapper from joint_imputation_pfn/common.py, common initialization per seed, same query CE, optimizer and schedule. Original transformer frozen; existing graph adapters/feature encoder/label decoder plus original zero-initialized mask embedding and token residual are trained. Native raw2-column values, original missing mask; PCFI uses the same existing imputer with100 iterations. Each normal arm has192 balanced exposures (32 per context/budget cell); random_cost384 (64 per cell). No new architecture/loss, no target fitting, final checkpoint only. Compare cost including cold candidate scoring and bank generation; extra random training is a conservative cost control only if its measured extra training cost covers charged scoring.
evaluation: Fresh64 base graphs, common input distribution for every trained arm. All6 context/budget cells have uniform source locations. Extra clustered sources4/context8, full features/context8, no-features and shuffled observed rows on exactly the primary query cohort. C,Q are label independent; query features are absent in every non-full condition. Full is a privileged information reference, not primary. Exact finite-family predictor, its no-feature prediction and empirical context-frequency baseline have no trainable weights. No acquisition/mask optimization at deployment.
primary: Accuracy on uniform4sources/context8total, averaged over3 fixed initialization seeds within each of64 base graphs. For each of entropy and decision on the Mask interface, require its difference against random, geometry and random_cost to have paired95%CI lower>0 (all3). Then compare all same-prior PCFI arms as the strong pipeline floor. Exact Bayes is a known-family information reference, not a baseline a learned model should exceed in expectation. NLL/Brier are secondary and cannot rescue accuracy failure. No test-selected subgroups or new tuning.
statistics: 5000 paired bootstrap resamples of base graphs, RNG17630000; condition on3 fixed training seeds. J and V are separate candidate tests, each3-control conjunction; intervals and other comparisons are pointwise unadjusted, exploratory pilot not confirmatory multiplicity-controlled evidence. Report each seed and all cells. Teacher expected accuracy and feature gain are separate from realized accuracy.
checks: Pre-lock independent dev graphs only: posterior normalization, Bayes rule direct likelihood calculation, class-swap symmetry, no-feature posterior, expected value convergence and mask ranks at4096draws, fresh-realization leakage poisoning, equal budgets/C-Q-source disjointness, deterministic model forward, gradients and common initial trainable state, observed-only PCFI. Source/config/reference/public checkpoint hashes locked before final bank generation. Recompute saved metrics/checkpoint hashes/actual updates/schedules and paired cohorts after training.
stop: No post-test extra loss, mask hyperparameter/teacher/family tuning, changing primary, checkpoint selection or extra training rescue. This is a small known finite-family mask-prior pilot; no real graph/unseen schema/new feature-law or paper novelty claim. If J/V or geometry selects the same masks, report that limitation. No claim prior historical banks lacked informative tasks.
